chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 25 (Legislature) contains 25 ILCS 170, the Lobbyist Registration Act, the core lobbying-disclosure statute.

Chapter 5 (General Provisions) contains 5 ILCS 420 (Illinois Governmental Ethics Act) and 5 ILCS 430 (State Officials and Employees Ethics Act), which house executive-branch lobbying / ethics-disclosure provisions parallel to the Lobbyist Registration Act.

notes: Illinois lobbying-disclosure regime is split across multiple ILCS chapters: 25 ILCS 170 under Chapter 25 (Legislature) for lobbyist registration, plus 5 ILCS 420 and 5 ILCS 430 under Chapter 5 (General Provisions) for governmental ethics and state officials ethics provisions tied to lobbying. Both chapters returned to capture the full regime.
